days.title: Christ the Consoler
days.alt: Christ stands in white with open arms; a man in red kneels pressing his face into His robe, and an old man with a staff sits slumped at His feet.
days.look: Look again at the tired man pressing his face into the folds of Christ’s robe. What would it be like to rest there for a moment, with nothing to carry?
days.license: Artist died 1890; faithful reproduction of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Jacopo Tintoretto - Elijah Fed by the Angel - WGA22548.jpg
days.title: Elijah Fed by the Angel
days.place: Scuola Grande di San Rocco, Venice
days.alt: An angel dives down through the branches toward the prophet Elijah, who lies asleep in a red robe beneath the tree.
days.look: Look again at the angel reaching down to the sleeping prophet. What small, ordinary kindness might God be sending to you today?
days.license: Artist died 1594; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Mantegna, Andrea - Agony in the Garden - National Gallery, London.jpg
days.title: The Agony in the Garden
days.alt: Jesus kneels alone in prayer on a bare rock above a walled city, with barren hills around him.
days.look: Look again at Jesus kneeling alone on the bare rock, far from any comfort. What would it be like to pray beside Him now, just as you are?
days.license: Artist died 1506; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Kiss of Judas
days.alt: In a crowd of soldiers and torches, Judas wraps his cloak around Jesus and kisses him while Jesus looks steadily back at him.
days.look: Look again at Jesus meeting Judas’s gaze. Jesus knows what it is to be betrayed by a friend. What would you like to tell Him about your own hurt?
days.license: Artist died 1337; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Barmhartige Samaritaan ontfermt zich over de gewonde reiziger, RP-P-OB-46.010.jpg
days.title: The Good Samaritan Tends the Wounded Traveler
days.alt: Under a spreading tree, a traveler kneels over a wounded man, tending him while his laden donkey waits nearby.
days.look: Look again at the traveler bending close to the wounded man. Where could you let yourself be cared for today?
days.license: Engraving; artist died 1712; Rijksmuseum public-domain release (Commons: CC0)

days.title: Jethro and Moses
days.alt: Moses, in a white head-cloth, sits in a tent while his father-in-law Jethro and the elders lean in to counsel him.
days.look: Look again at Moses listening to those around him. Who might God be sending to share this weight with you?

days.file: V&A - Raphael, Christ's Charge to Peter (1515).jpg
days.title: Christ’s Charge to Peter
days.place: Royal Collection, on loan to the Victoria and Albert Museum, London
days.alt: Christ stands beside a flock of sheep and points toward Peter, who kneels before him as the other apostles look on.
days.look: Look again at Peter kneeling before Christ, with the sheep behind. What does it mean that Jesus asks for your love before your work?
days.license: Artist died 1520; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: 1563 Tintoretto Moses Striking the Rock anagoria.JPG
days.title: Moses Striking the Rock
days.alt: Moses stands with outstretched arm as water pours from the rock and women and children bend to drink.
days.look: Look again at the people bending down to drink from the rock. Where is God quietly opening a spring in your own dry ground?
days.license: Artist died 1594; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: "The good Shepherd" mosaic - Mausoleum of Galla Placidia.jpg
days.title: The Good Shepherd
days.alt: In a Ravenna mosaic, Christ the Good Shepherd sits among six sheep and rests a hand on one of them.
days.look: Look again at the shepherd resting his hand on a sheep. Can you picture yourself as the one he is gently looking after?
days.license: 5th-century mosaic; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
